Client-to-client protocol.fact: DCC CHAT is normally initiated using a CTCP handshake. The user wishing to establish the connection sends the following CTCP to the target, DCC CHAT protocol ip port, where ip and port are the IP address and port number of the sender, and are expressed as integers.

Client-to-client protocol.question: protocol is chat for standard DCC _____

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society
Client-to-client protocol.question: Once a connection is established, the protocol used for DCC _____ is very simple: users exchange CRLF-terminated messages
Client-to-client protocol.fact: The user wishing to establish the connection sends the following CTCP to the target, DCC CHAT protocol ip port, where ip and port are the IP address and port number of the sender, and are expressed as integers. protocol is chat for standard DCC CHAT.

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society
Client-to-client protocol.question: Messages that begin with an ASCII 001 (control-A, represented below by [^A]) and the word _____, and are terminated by another ASCII 001, are interpreted as emotes: [^A]ACTION waves goodbye[^A]
Client-to-client protocol.fact: Messages that begin with an ASCII 001 (control-A, represented below by [^A]) and the word ACTION, and are terminated by another ASCII 001, are interpreted as emotes: [^A]ACTION waves goodbye[^A]. Messages that begin (and optionally end) with ASCII 001 are interpreted as special commands; the command ACTION represents an emote, while others cause lines to be drawn on the user's whiteboard surface, or allow the two clients to negotiate a set of features.

Client-to-client protocol.question: DCC _____ is initiated with a handshake similar to DCC CHAT, with the protocol chat replaced by wboard: DCC CHAT wboard ip port
Client-to-client protocol.fact: DCC Whiteboard is initiated with a handshake similar to DCC CHAT, with the protocol chat replaced by wboard: DCC CHAT wboard ip port. Messages that begin (and optionally end) with ASCII 001 are interpreted as special commands; the command ACTION represents an emote, while others cause lines to be drawn on the user's whiteboard surface, or allow the two clients to negotiate a set of features.

Client-to-client protocol.question: Once the connection is established, the two clients exchange _____-terminated messages
Client-to-client protocol.fact: Once a connection is established, the protocol used for DCC CHAT is very simple: users exchange CRLF-terminated messages. Once the connection is established, the two clients exchange CRLF-terminated messages.

Client-to-client protocol.question: The original handshake consisted of the sender sending the following _____ to the receiver: DCC SEND filename ip port

Client-to-client protocol.fact: As with DCC CHAT, ip and port are the IP address and port where the sending machine will be listening for an incoming connection.

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society
Client-to-client protocol.question: It is common practice to add the file size as a last argument: DCC _____ filename ip port filesize
Client-to-client protocol.fact: The original handshake consisted of the sender sending the following CTCP to the receiver: DCC SEND filename ip port. As with DCC CHAT, ip and port are the IP address and port where the sending machine will be listening for an incoming connection.

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society
Client-to-client protocol.question: Another extension, _____, or turbo DCC, removes the acknowledgements, but requires a slightly modified handshake and is not widely supported
Client-to-client protocol.fact: Another extension, TDCC, or turbo DCC, removes the acknowledgements, but requires a slightly modified handshake and is not widely supported. Client-to-client protocol.fact: The XMIT handshake differs somewhat from the SEND handshake. The sender sends a CTCP offering a file to the receiver: DCC XMIT protocol ip port[ name[ size[ MIME-type]]] Square brackets here enclose optional parts.

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society
Client-to-client protocol.question: If the receiver does not implement the protocol used, it will send back a CTCP reply of the format: _____ DCC CHAT protocol unavailable
Client-to-client protocol.fact: If the receiver does not implement the protocol used, it will send back a CTCP reply of the format: ERRMSG DCC CHAT protocol unavailable. If the receiver declines the transfer, it sends the following CTCP reply: ERRMSG DCC CHAT protocol declined.

Client-to-client protocol.fact: The CTCP protocol was implemented by Michael Sandrof in 1990 for ircII version 2.1, while the DCC protocol was implemented by Troy Rollo in 1991 for version 2.1.2.

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society
Client-to-client protocol.question: If the receiver declines the transfer, it sends the following CTCP reply: _____ DCC CHAT protocol declined
Client-to-client protocol.fact: If the receiver does not implement the protocol used, it will send back a CTCP reply of the format: ERRMSG DCC CHAT protocol unavailable. If the receiver declines the transfer, it sends the following CTCP reply: ERRMSG DCC CHAT protocol declined.

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society
Client-to-client protocol.question: In the case of the clear protocol, the _____ server will, upon receiving a connection, send a 32-bit time t in network byte order, representing the file's modification time
Client-to-client protocol.fact: In the case of the clear protocol, the XMIT server will, upon receiving a connection, send a 32-bit time t in network byte order, representing the file's modification time. While faster than SEND, XMIT carries one of the same limitations in that it is impossible to tell how big the file is, unless its size is specified in the CTCP negotiation or known beforehand.

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society
Client-to-client protocol.question: While faster than _____, XMIT carries one of the same limitations in that it is impossible to tell how big the file is, unless its size is specified in the CTCP negotiation or known beforehand
Client-to-client protocol.fact: In the case of the clear protocol, the XMIT server will, upon receiving a connection, send a 32-bit time t in network byte order, representing the file's modification time. Presumably based on the modification time of the local file, the client will then send another network byte order long, an offset which the server should seek to when sending the file.

Client-to-client protocol.fact: Because of widespread firewalling and reduction of end-to-end transparency because of NAT, the initiator might not be able to act as a server. DCC Server has moderate support, but is not standard on all clients (see Comparison of Internet Relay Chat clients).

Client-to-client protocol.question: The target then replies with, _____ target nick, and the rest proceeds according to standard DCC CHAT protocol
Client-to-client protocol.fact: For a CHAT, the initiator sends 1000 initiator nick. The target then replies with, 1000 target nick, and the rest proceeds according to standard DCC CHAT protocol.

Client-to-client protocol.question: The target replies with, _____ target nick resume position, where resume position is the offset in the file from which to start

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society
Client-to-client protocol.question: This method can be used by _____ channels to fill their XDCC bots from other XDCC channels
Client-to-client protocol.fact: Then, once the nick and server are configured, the user can then request a file from an XDCC bot with the file transfer being forwarded to the other user. This method can be used by XDCC channels to fill their XDCC bots from other XDCC channels.

Client-to-client protocol.subject: Women & Society

Client-to-client protocol.fact: The initiator requests the port the target is listening on by sending the CTCP query, RDCC function comment, where function is c for chat, s for send, or f for file server. Client-to-client protocol.fact: The initiator requests the port the target is listening on by sending the CTCP query, RDCC function comment, where function is c for chat, s for send, or f for file server.
